data.gender_notes: Tapos is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Tapos refers to the sparks produced when two objects are struck together. It symbolizes the intense heat and passion that can ignite creativity and innovation. The name Tapos carries the meaning “Heat, Passion, Creativity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Tapos usually hope their child will grow to embody heat, passion, creativity and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This concept is reflective of the creative energy that emerges from such encounters and can result in powerful innovations, ideas, and artistic creations. This idea is deeply embedded in various aspects of Indian culture, particularly in the fields of science, arts, and philosophy.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, Tapos is regarded as the inner fire igniting the soul. The term represents the Divine Spark, the divine essence within every being, inspiring individuals to explore their inner depths, explore wisdom, and seek spiritual growth. The essence of Tapos is found in the Upanishads as 'Atma Tapas', which means 'Self-Penance' or 'Self-Austerity'. This portrays the concept of self-realization as the unique journey each person must undertake to connect with their divine source.
